name: Sharp Panda 27
author: JkHuger
description: Outlined rounded gray login form that changes colour on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, background-color changes from transparent to #000000, text color changes from #000 to #ffffff. On focus, transform becomes translateX(113px) translateY(-15px), font-size becomes 0.8em, padding becomes 5px 10px.
